name: EWIA.tech UG (haftungsbeschränkt)

By fusing the Galileo High Accuracy Service with advanced AI error-correction, we unlock high-precision GNSS where it matters most: in everyday mobile devices, at a fraction of the current cost. Today, high-precision accuracy is gated by expensive receivers and high service complexity. EWIA will make sub-meter accuracy accessible and software-simple on phones, unlocking new value across navigation, telematics, micromobility, logistics, agriculture, AR, and safety – expanding the precision segment rather than merely displacing it. We provide an SDK that integrates in minutes, upgrading any app using the device’s native location. The result is better accuracy, smoother performance, lower total cost of ownership, and faster time-to-value – without changing user hardware. By democratizing high-precision GNSS on off-the-shelf mobiles, EWIA.tech broadens the serviceable market for precision location and enables a wave of innovative applications.
